author: _Windows_95_
body:
Why are the staff on this server so rude? They also seem to always abuse their power and ban people who are innocent. I was recently banned off your idiotic Minecraft server, and I know several other people who were also falsely banned.

I suggest you should stop recruiting these terrible and incompetent staff members, as this would greatly improve your terribly flawed server. Avicus Network is becoming less and less popular every day, and having these staff who abuse their powers is a major reason why the demise of Avicus Network started. Staff on this server are also very rude. I've never had this problem on any other Minecraft server, so I suggest you make the staff applications more stringent.

Incompetent and stupid staff members should all be immediately deprived of all of their powers.
